title: Conferring honorary citizenship of the United States on Bernardo de Gálvez y Madrid, Viscount of Galveston and Count of Gálvez.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Confers honorary U.S. citizenship on Bernardo de Galvez y Madrid, Viscount of Galveston and Count of Galvez.

summary.headline: Congress gave honorary U.S. citizenship to Bernardo de Gálvez, an 18th-century Spanish military leader who helped the American colonies during the Revolutionary War.
summary.what_it_does: This joint resolution confers honorary United States citizenship on Bernardo de Gálvez y Madrid, who was Viscount of Galveston and Count of Gálvez. Honorary citizenship is a symbolic honor and does not create a legal path to immigration status or other rights for anyone. The official summary is brief and does not describe any further provisions.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The resolution was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the summary does not give a separate effective date.
